matchedObjects.name: XDX Supplier Information
matchedObjects.description: Supplier lookup and details, paginated addresses/sites/contacts, and explicitly authorized create operations for suppliers and their children. POST callers validate writable JSON fields, parent references and uniqueness, then reconcile outcomes before retries.

functions.label: ListSuppliers
functions.summary: List one page of suppliers. Return items and count, limit, offset, hasMore. Continue from offset + count while hasMore is true; never describe one page as the full catalog. Includes active and inactive suppliers visible to the signed-in user.

functions.label: FindSupplierByFullName
functions.summary: Find suppliers by full name using an equality comparison. Return every matching supplier and native pagination metadata. Name matching follows the Fusion REST service collation; no case-insensitive or fuzzy-match guarantee. Caller must escape embedded apostrophes by doubling them before supplying supplierName.

functions.label: FindSuppliersByPartialName
functions.summary: Find suppliers whose name contains the supplied text using a LIKE contains comparison. Return every match with pagination metadata. Matching follows Fusion REST collation. Caller must double apostrophes; percent and underscore in the input retain LIKE wildcard semantics. Do not supply blank text; use ListSuppliers instead.

functions.label: GetSupplierDetails
functions.summary: Retrieve the scalar supplier profile by its previously resolved supplier ID. Native Fusion permissions apply. Child collections are retrieved separately; no automatic expansion.

functions.label: ListSupplierAddresses
functions.summary: Retrieve one page of addresses for one supplier. Optional narrowing through a caller-authored framework-v4 rowmatch filter; default selects all child IDs. Preserve count, limit, offset and hasMore. Empty items is valid; errors are not empty results. Continue at offset + count while hasMore is true.

functions.label: ListSupplierSites
functions.summary: Retrieve one page of sites for one supplier. Optional narrowing through a caller-authored framework-v4 rowmatch filter; default selects all child IDs. Preserve count, limit, offset and hasMore. Empty items is valid; errors are not empty results. Continue at offset + count while hasMore is true.

functions.label: ListSupplierContacts
functions.summary: Retrieve one page of contacts for one supplier. Optional narrowing through a caller-authored framework-v4 rowmatch filter; default selects all child IDs. Preserve count, limit, offset and hasMore. Empty items is valid; errors are not empty results. Continue at offset + count while hasMore is true.

functions.label: CreateSupplier
functions.summary: Create one Supplier with explicit schema-mapped fields. String values must be JSON-safe; callers validate names, lengths, lookup values and parent references. No generated IDs or audit fields are accepted. Reconcile uncertain results before retries.

functions.label: CreateSupplierAddress
functions.summary: Create one SupplierAddress with explicit schema-mapped fields. String values must be JSON-safe; callers validate names, lengths, lookup values and parent references. No generated IDs or audit fields are accepted. Reconcile uncertain results before retries.

functions.label: CreateSupplierSite
functions.summary: Create one SupplierSite with explicit schema-mapped fields. String values must be JSON-safe; callers validate names, lengths, lookup values and parent references. No generated IDs or audit fields are accepted. Reconcile uncertain results before retries.

functions.label: CreateSupplierContact
functions.summary: Create one SupplierContact with explicit schema-mapped fields. String values must be JSON-safe; callers validate names, lengths, lookup values and parent references. No generated IDs or audit fields are accepted. Reconcile uncertain results before retries.

functions.label: FindSuppliersByValidatedFilter
functions.summary: Search suppliers by an application-validated ID, number, exact name or literal partial name filter; preserve paging and require explicit selection.

matchedObjects.name: XDX Supplier Procurement Business Units
matchedObjects.description: Paged reference lookup of procurement business units and agent actions for supplier site forms; no write permission inference.

functions.label: getall_procurementBusinessUnitsLOV
functions.summary: Retrieve a page of authenticated procurement BU and action rows. Follow hasMore; collapse choices by exact BU ID only after checking name consistency. This is not supplier-write authorization.
